rows.rationale: When _numeric_row_bbox returns None, the destruction check is still scoped to fitz.Rect(table.bbox) at reconstruct.py:170 — exactly the overrun scope PR #192 review finding 2 asked to stop using. A text-strategy grid whose only numerics sit in the bbox overrun (notes, ticks, page numbers) can be rejected as 'destroyed' even though no numeric row was ever in the table proper. The fix direction is in the issue: skip destruction when numeric_scope is None, or refuse to use table.bbox. _looks_tabular's numeric-fraction gate makes the None branch uncommon, but the existing test only covers the non-None scope, so the hole is unguarded.

rows.rationale: _destroyed_numeric_tokens at reconstruct.py:377 filters candidates with anchored _NUM_TOKEN_RE.match(text) AND _NUMERIC_RE.search(text). That anchored regex rejects 0.67***, U+2212, $0.67, (0.14) — exactly the decorated numerics this repo already accepts elsewhere via native_verifier.is_numeric_token at native_verifier.py:488, which strips presentation first. If the text-strategy grid splits '0.67***' the same way it split '0.67', A2 never fires and a silent wrong number ships. Fix: drive the candidate filter with is_numeric_token (presentation-strip first). Survival predicate stays exact-string 'text in raw_cell' on the original token.

rows.rationale: No tables/pipeline guard rejects residual LaTeX table commands in emitted markdown. Pages 51 and 63 (TICKET-D2 evidence) ship status: success with three-cell headers in place of the intended eight. Flattening spanning headers at emission is the real repair and is larger; do the guard first.
